t: The `pip freeze` Baseline: A Brute-Force Solution to Dependency Hell
s: This article details debugging a macOS segmentation fault caused by volatile Python dependencies within a Nix environment. The core issue was an auto-updating workflow overriding local fixes, with the solution found by establishing a fully pinned 'baseline' environment using `pip freeze` to identify the problematic transitive dependency.
sub: Nix reproducible environments vs. rapid Python iteration
Debugging segmentation faults in Python/Nix integration
Using `pip freeze` to establish a known-good dependency baseline
Iterative pinning strategy for transitive dependency identification
